informal: **The dyadic fiber at α = 2.** For every k, the pair (1/2^k, 2) is good: the sequence ⌊2^n / 2^k⌋ is additively complete because at index n = m + k it equals the exact power 2^m, so its range contains all powers of two, which already form an additively complete set. Uses monotonicity IsAddComplete.mono.
